name: Potiphar
title: Pharaoh's Court Official
summary: Potiphar was an Egyptian court official and captain of Pharaoh's guard who bought Joseph as a slave. He was a wealthy and influential man in Egypt, and under his roof Joseph demonstrated his leadership abilities. Potiphar's wife tried to seduce Joseph, and when he rejected her, she falsely accused him of attempted assault.

keyEvents.title: Buys Joseph as a Slave
keyEvents.description: Potiphar bought Joseph from the Midianite merchants who had brought him to Egypt after his brothers sold him.

keyEvents.title: Puts Joseph in Charge of His Household
keyEvents.description: Potiphar saw that the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in everything he did. Therefore, he put Joseph in charge of his entire household and all that he owned.

keyEvents.title: Blessing on Potiphar's House
keyEvents.description: Because of Joseph, the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house, and the Lord's blessing was upon everything Potiphar owned, both in the house and in the fields.

keyEvents.title: Throws Joseph into Prison
keyEvents.description: When Potiphar's wife falsely accused Joseph of attempting to assault her, Potifar became furious and threw Joseph into prison.
